description: This file contains functions and scripts for service registration and event handling in an embedded or Linux-based system. It manages registration, deregistration, and callback handling for system events via sysevent commands, including helper functions for managing asynchronous event handlers. It also includes functions to register services for default and custom system events, and to unregister services from events.

methods.name: sm_save_async
methods.description: Saves the async event ID associated with a service and event for later cleanup.

methods.name: sm_rm_event
methods.description: Removes an event registration, including canceling its async handler.

methods.name: sm_register_one_event
methods.description: Registers a single event for a service, setting up the handler and associated parameters.

methods.name: sm_register_for_default_events
methods.description: Registers a service for standard lifecycle events: start, stop, restart.

methods.name: sm_unregister
methods.description: Unregisters all events for a given service, cleaning up async handlers.

methods.name: sm_register
methods.description: Registers a service for default and custom events, initializing necessary registration and cleanup.
